closes.Y2.B9.S6: knowing that an hour has 60 minutes and using it (half an hour = 30 minutes; minutes in 2 hours)
closes.Y2.B9.S7: knowing that a day has 24 hours and using it to compare durations (more or less than a day)

table_data.name: Tables
table_data.teaches: reading and completing simple tables and tally-to-number tables
table_data.representation: a two-column table with blanks; fill in the counts; answer one question

closes.Y2.B10.S2: reading and completing a simple table of counts (made from a tally) and answering how many / how many more

block_diagram.name: Block Diagrams
block_diagram.teaches: reading and drawing block diagrams (one square = one) with a scale in 1s or 2s
block_diagram.representation: a squared grid with labelled columns; count the blocks or colour to build

closes.Y2.B10.S3: reads a 1-to-1 bar chart (how many, how many more); drawing a block diagram, and blocks stacked as squares (one square = one) rather than bars, are not dealt

pictogram_scale.name: Pictograms with a Key (option)
pictogram_scale.teaches: drawing pictograms where one picture stands for 2, 5 or 10, including half pictures

closes.Y2.B10.S6: a key where one picture stands for 2, 5 or 10

ordinal.name: 1st, 2nd, 3rd
ordinal.teaches: ordinal numbers (first to tenth) and their abbreviations for position in a line
ordinal.representation: a line of line-drawn children or objects with a start flag; circle the 3rd, write the position of the star

position_map.name: Where Is It? Positions and Maps
position_map.teaches: position and direction language (on, under, next to, behind, in front, left, right, forwards, backwards), following and giving simple directions on a grid map
position_map.representation: a simple picture map on a square grid; answer where-is questions or follow arrows

turns.name: Whole, Half and Quarter Turns
turns.teaches: describing turns (whole, half, quarter, three-quarter; clockwise, anticlockwise) of an arrow or object
turns.representation: an arrow or object drawn before and after a turn; circle the turn from a word bank

closes.Y2.B11.S3: describing whole, half, quarter and three-quarter turns, clockwise and anticlockwise, of an object or an arrow

movement.name: Describe Movement
movement.teaches: describing movement on a grid (up, down, left, right, number of squares) and combining movement with quarter/half turns
movement.representation: a square grid with a start and an object; write the moves; option: follow a route

closes.Y2.B11.S2: describing movement on a grid by direction and number of squares (2 squares right, 3 squares up)
closes.Y2.B11.S4: describing a route that combines moves on a grid with turns (forward 3, quarter turn clockwise, forward 2)

pattern_turns.name: Shape Patterns with Turns
pattern_turns.teaches: continuing patterns made by turning a shape (quarter turns clockwise)
pattern_turns.representation: a row of arrow or shape tiles turning; draw or circle the next one

closes.Y2.B11.S5: continuing and completing a pattern in which a shape turns a quarter or a half turn each time
